description: This file defines the utility class RomAttributeParser that provides static methods for parsing various attribute strings and byte data related to ROM configuration, including endianess, hex strings, storage types, scale types, table types, byte values, integer values, file sizes, and float conversions. It serves as a helper class for reading and interpreting XML attributes associated with ROM data in the RomRaider project.

classes.name: RomAttributeParser
classes.description: A final utility class providing static methods to parse and convert ROM XML attribute strings and binary data.

methods.name: parseEndian
methods.description: Parses an endian string ('big' or 'little') into corresponding constant from Settings.

methods.name: parseHexString
methods.description: Converts a hex string (with optional '0x' prefix) into an integer.

methods.name: parseStorageType
methods.description: Determines storage type constant based on input string ('float', 'uintx', 'intx', or numeric).

methods.name: parseStorageDataSign
methods.description: Returns true if the storage type is signed ('int...'), false otherwise.

methods.name: parseScaleType
methods.description: Identifies scale type ('inverse' or 'linear') based on input string.

methods.name: parseTableType
methods.description: Determines table type constant (3D, 2D, X Axis, Y Axis, 1D) based on input string.

methods.name: parseByteValue
methods.description: Extracts a long value from a byte array considering endianess, address, length, and signedness.

methods.name: parseIntegerValue
methods.description: Creates a byte array from an integer value considering endianess and length.

methods.name: parseFileSize
methods.description: Parses a string indicating file size (with 'kb' or 'mb') into an integer number of bytes.

methods.name: floatToByte
methods.description: Converts a float to a 4-byte array considering endianess.

methods.name: byteToFloat
methods.description: Converts a 4-byte array into a float considering endianess.
